Name: Bird Replacements for Children
Author: starsailorix
Description:
essentially a content patcher and 1.6 compatible version of Ankoku’s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/309]Bird Replacements for Babies and Toddlers[/url]

[b]note:[/b] currently no solid plans to make recolours of other types of birds at the moment, i just wanted a usable version of this out for my own playthroughs

if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url], you are able to change the type of bird based on the skin colour of the original child
(not in my current time + skill level to figure out how to randomise the type of bird ;-;)

[b]summary[/b]
[list][*]replaces baby + toddler sprites with birds 
[*]replaces baby crib with bird cage
[*]changes marriage & adoption/pregnancy related dialogue to bird related talk
[/list]
[b]installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] are installed
[*]download and unzip﻿ the "[i][CP] Bird Replacements for Children[/i]" folder into your mods folder
[/list]
[b]compatibility[/b]
there shouldn't be anything game-breaking occurring, however if you have any mods which affect children, the crib or related dialogue, there may be inconsistencies mainly due to load order- the only potential mod i've taken into account is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners & Friendships[/url] (as i use it myself)
if i have time later, i will try to make the mod more robust

please let me know any issues regarding missed dialogue + anything similar

Manifest.Name: Bird Replacements for Children
Manifest.Description: Replaces your human children with birds.
